correctness.rationale: Exact rational Cayley identity (symbolic cancellation), positivity of every nonunit log coordinate, a primitive 5x5 companion, and fixed-point super-exponential contraction yield a bounded forcing tending to c super-exponentially. Shifting by c/2 turns the scalar dynamics into a uniformly diagonalizable five-root recurrence with summable exponential-weighted forcing. Eigenprojector variation of constants yields five convergent coefficient series and a super-exponentially decaying remainder. The strict Perron coefficient and b-derivative follow from positive left weights and dominated convergence. Roots are distinct with certified disjoint rational isolating disks; checker replay and independent high-precision diagnostics corroborate critical algebra.

value.rationale: The natural nonlinear positive 5D map has zero Jacobian at the equilibrium, so linearized stability gives no convergence clock. The theorem determines the complete hierarchy of logarithmic attraction rates: universal Perron magnitude plus an unusual exponentially growing complex oscillation in the logarithmic remainder, then contracting complex modes, all with explicit orbit-specific series. It also quantifies the strict effect of the physical additive b parameter at zero. These solve a motivated precision-of-attraction gap beyond qualitative GAS and its sign semi-cycles.
